questions.explanation: 结合语境，作者即将实现第一次独自出国的梦想，这体现了作者拥有了去做这件事的“自由”(freedom)。后文提到的“骄傲与认可”也源于这种独立自主的自由。priority优先权，excuse借口，urge冲动，均不符语境。
questions.supplement:
A(priority): 语境句: Education should be a top priority for the government. 固定搭配: give priority to, top priority
B(freedom): 语境句: The scholarship gave her the freedom to study abroad. 固定搭配: freedom of speech, have the freedom to do
C(excuse): 语境句: He made up a clumsy excuse for being late. 固定搭配: make an excuse, find an excuse
D(urge): 语境句: She felt an overwhelming urge to tell him the truth. 固定搭配: have an urge to do, fight the urge

questions.explanation: 作者降落在完全陌生的城市，且是独自旅行(solo trip)，因此只能“依靠”自己。rely on意为“依赖，依靠”。look for寻找，trust in信任，reflect upon反思，均不合逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(look for): 语境句: I am looking for my lost keys everywhere. 固定搭配: look for a job, look for help
B(rely on): 语境句: As babies, we rely entirely on our parents. 固定搭配: rely on oneself, rely heavily on
C(trust in): 语境句: You must trust in your own abilities to succeed. 固定搭配: trust in God, put trust in
D(reflect upon): 语境句: The manager needed time to reflect upon the problem. 固定搭配: reflect upon oneself, reflect upon the past

questions.explanation: 作者虽然来到陌生的城市，但并不害怕，打算利用好在这里的每一个“时刻”(moment)，好好享受旅行。take advantage of every moment意为“把握每分每秒”。
questions.supplement:
A(message): 语境句: Please leave a message after the beep. 固定搭配: leave a message, send a message
B(flight): 语境句: Our flight was cancelled due to the bad weather. 固定搭配: book a flight, direct flight
C(moment): 语境句: He waited for the perfect moment to ask the question. 固定搭配: at the moment, take advantage of every moment
D(platform): 语境句: The train will depart from platform 3. 固定搭配: social platform, an online platform

questions.explanation: 冒号后的问题是“我真的要孤身一人吗？”，这是出发前最“困扰”(bother)作者的问题。bother表示“使烦恼，困扰”。interested感兴趣，threatened威胁，comforted安慰，均不符合担忧的情绪语境。
questions.supplement:
A(bothered): 语境句: The noise from the construction site really bothered me. 固定搭配: bother sb with sth, can't be bothered
B(interested): 语境句: I am particularly interested in traditional Chinese medicine. 固定搭配: be interested in, keep sb interested
C(threatened): 语境句: The continuous rain threatened to ruin our picnic. 固定搭配: feel threatened, threaten to do
D(comforted): 语境句: She comforted the crying child with a warm hug. 固定搭配: comfort sb, offer comfort

questions.explanation: 前文提到作者一直担心自己会孤身一人，但实际上却遇到了很多人。这种情况与预期相反，因此用Strangely (奇怪的是) 来引出这种出乎意料的转折。
questions.supplement:
A(Initially): 语境句: Initially, I didn't like the plan, but I changed my mind later. 固定搭配: initially believe, initially plan
B(Strangely): 语境句: Strangely enough, he didn't seem angry at all. 固定搭配: strangely enough, behave strangely
C(Absolutely): 语境句: You are absolutely right about this issue. 固定搭配: absolutely necessary, absolutely true
D(Hopefully): 语境句: Hopefully, we will arrive before it gets dark. 固定搭配: hopefully finish, wait hopefully

questions.explanation: 在这第一次独自旅行中，作者“遇到，邂逅”(encounter)了许多人。encounter指偶然遇见。assist协助，amuse逗乐，guide引导，均不符合“偶遇各种各样的旅行者”的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(assisted): 语境句: The software assisted users in managing their time. 固定搭配: assist sb in doing, assist with sth
B(amused): 语境句: His funny story amused all the guests at the party. 固定搭配: keep sb amused, be amused by
C(encountered): 语境句: We encountered several difficulties during the project. 固定搭配: encounter difficulties, encounter resistance
D(guided): 语境句: The local expert guided us through the dense forest. 固定搭配: guide sb through, guide dog

questions.explanation: 前文说遇到了很多人，因此作者“很少”(rarely)是一个人，甚至在想安静看书时也是如此。finally最终，apparently显然，basically基本上，都不符合句意逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(finally): 语境句: After months of hard work, they finally finished the task. 固定搭配: finally succeed, finally arrive
B(rarely): 语境句: She rarely goes out at night for safety reasons. 固定搭配: rarely seen, very rarely
C(apparently): 语境句: Apparently, he had forgotten about our appointment. 固定搭配: apparently successful, become apparently clear
D(basically): 语境句: The two models are basically the same in function. 固定搭配: basically agree, basically speaking

questions.explanation: 作者在独自旅行迷路时，会想象如果和家人在一起情况会有多么“不同”(different)。这里是在对比“独自一人”和“与家人同游”的区别。awkward尴尬，stressful有压力，complex复杂，均不如different能概括对比的含义。
questions.supplement:
A(awkward): 语境句: There was an awkward silence after his rude comment. 固定搭配: awkward situation, feel awkward
B(stressful): 语境句: Moving to a new city can be a highly stressful experience. 固定搭配: stressful job, stressful situation
C(complex): 语境句: The human brain is a highly complex organ. 固定搭配: complex system, complex problem
D(different): 语境句: Everyone learns in a slightly different way. 固定搭配: totally different, different from

questions.explanation: 夜间大巴上旁边的人一直跟作者说话，导致作者无法入睡，这件事让人感到“烦人的”(annoying)。appealing吸引人的，frightening令人害怕的，inspiring鼓舞人心的，均不符合“让人睡不着觉的喋喋不休”的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(annoying): 语境句: It is annoying when people interrupt you while speaking. 固定搭配: highly annoying, find sth annoying
B(appealing): 语境句: The idea of working from home is very appealing to me. 固定搭配: visually appealing, appealing offer
C(frightening): 语境句: The thunderstorm last night was a frightening experience. 固定搭配: frightening speed, frightening reality
D(inspiring): 语境句: The headmaster gave an inspiring speech to the graduates. 固定搭配: inspiring story, truly inspiring

questions.explanation: 本题存在词汇复现。后文紧接着提到“I only felt huge positive energy!”（我只感到了巨大的正能量），因此这里是说这次旅行给了我巨大的“能量”(energy)。
questions.supplement:
A(energy): 语境句: It takes a lot of time and energy to raise a child. 固定搭配: positive energy, conserve energy
B(warmth): 语境句: She smiled with genuine warmth and welcomed us in. 固定搭配: feel the warmth, bring warmth
C(enjoyment): 语境句: Reading brings him a great deal of enjoyment. 固定搭配: pure enjoyment, find enjoyment in
D(honor): 语境句: It is a great honor to be invited to speak here. 固定搭配: in honor of, a sense of honor

questions.explanation: 由于旅行带来了巨大的正能量，因此出发前所有的怀疑和恐惧都“消失”了(disappeared)。deepened加深，remained保留，emerged出现，均与语境表达的积极结果相悖。
questions.supplement:
A(disappeared): 语境句: The sun disappeared behind a thick cloud. 固定搭配: completely disappear, gradually disappear
B(deepened): 语境句: The crisis deepened as the weather conditions worsened. 固定搭配: deepen understanding, deepen ties
C(remained): 语境句: Despite the failure, he remained optimistic about the future. 固定搭配: remain calm, remain unchanged
D(emerged): 语境句: New evidence emerged during the police investigation. 固定搭配: emerge from, newly emerged

questions.explanation: throughout my stay there意为“在那儿逗留期间”。stay在此作名词，表示停留的时间。service服务，wait等待，research研究，均不符合旅行语境。
questions.supplement:
A(service): 语境句: The restaurant is famous for its excellent customer service. 固定搭配: customer service, medical service
B(stay): 语境句: Enjoy your stay at our hotel! 固定搭配: a pleasant stay, during one's stay
C(wait): 语境句: We had a long wait for the train to arrive. 固定搭配: a long wait, lie in wait
D(research): 语境句: She is doing research into the causes of the disease. 固定搭配: do research on/into, scientific research

questions.explanation: 由but引出转折，虽然是一个计划得很周密的旅行，但它仍然是我所经历过的最“充满意外的”(unexpected)旅行。后一句“there will always be surprises and accidents”也是对unexpected的同义解释。
questions.supplement:
A(unnecessary): 语境句: We should try to avoid making unnecessary mistakes. 固定搭配: unnecessary trouble, completely unnecessary
B(unavoidable): 语境句: Mistakes are unavoidable when you are learning a new language. 固定搭配: unavoidable consequence, seem unavoidable
C(uneventful): 语境句: The flight was smooth and uneventful, which was a relief. 固定搭配: uneventful journey, relatively uneventful
D(unexpected): 语境句: He made an unexpected visit to his old school. 固定搭配: unexpected result, totally unexpected

questions.explanation: 前文提到“It was a very well-planned trip”，此处顺承该句意：“无论我们多么努力地去计划(plan)旅行，总会有惊喜和意外”。
questions.supplement:
A(plan): 语境句: It is crucial to plan your essay before you start writing. 固定搭配: plan ahead, carefully plan
B(extend): 语境句: We decided to extend our holiday by two more days. 固定搭配: extend a deadline, extend one's stay
C(adjust): 语境句: It took her a while to adjust to the new environment. 固定搭配: adjust to, adjust the volume
D(support): 语境句: My family has always supported me in my career choices. 固定搭配: fully support, financially support

questions.explanation: 经历过这次充满惊喜和正能量的独自旅行后，作者现在确实“理解”(understand)了什么是“丰富且令人难忘的经历”。suspect怀疑，remember记得，deny否认，均不契合作者旅行后的感悟与升华。
questions.supplement:
A(suspect): 语境句: The police suspect him of stealing the expensive jewelry. 固定搭配: suspect sb of sth, strongly suspect
B(remember): 语境句: Please remember to turn off the lights when you leave. 固定搭配: remember doing sth, remember to do sth
C(understand): 语境句: I can completely understand why she is so upset. 固定搭配: fully understand, be easy to understand
D(deny): 语境句: He could not deny the fact that he had made a mistake. 固定搭配: deny doing sth, strongly deny

vocab_pack.definition_en: to get on a ship, aircraft, train, etc.
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 boarding 为动名词，作状语，表示“在登机时”。
vocab_pack.example_en: We will board the plane at Gate 10.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们将在10号登机口登机。
vocab_pack.from_passage: While boarding the plane, I felt an excitement rise in me.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make a dream come true
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为不定式短语，与 be about to 连用，表“即将实现梦想”。
vocab_pack.example_en: She worked hard to realize her dream of studying abroad.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她努力工作以实现出国留学的梦想。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I was about to realize a dream — traveling abroad alone for the first time.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to go to a foreign country by oneself
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 traveling abroad alone 为动名词短语，作同位语解释前面的 dream。
vocab_pack.example_en: He plans to travel abroad alone next summer.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他计划明年夏天独自出国旅行。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I was about to realize a dream — traveling abroad alone for the first time.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have the right or opportunity to go
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 had 为过去式，与不定式 to go 构成复合谓语。
vocab_pack.example_en: As an adult, you have the freedom to choose your own path.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 作为成年人，你有选择自己道路的自由。
vocab_pack.from_passage: And I had the freedom to go!

vocab_pack.definition_en: a combination of different things
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，在句中作表语。
vocab_pack.example_en: She felt a mixture of excitement and nervousness before the exam.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 考试前她感到既兴奋又紧张。
vocab_pack.from_passage: It was a mixture of pride, recognition and admiration for myself.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to depend on oneself; to be self-reliant
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 rely on myself 为不定式短语，与 would have to 连用；myself 为反身代词，与主语 I 呼应。
vocab_pack.example_en: You need to learn to rely on yourself when you grow up.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 长大后你需要学会靠自己。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I would have to rely on myself in this totally strange city.

vocab_pack.definition_en: completely unfamiliar
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词短语，修饰后面的 city。
vocab_pack.example_en: Moving to a totally strange country can be challenging.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 搬到一个完全陌生的国家可能很有挑战性。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I would have to rely on myself in this totally strange city.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make good use of an opportunity
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为不定式短语（was going to take advantage of...），后接宾语 every moment。
vocab_pack.example_en: You should take advantage of the fine weather to go hiking.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你应该利用好天气去远足。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I was going to take advantage of every moment.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause worry, trouble, or annoyance
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 bothered 为一般过去时，主语是 question（第三人称单数），后面接 me most。
vocab_pack.example_en: The noise from the street bothers me a lot.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 街上的噪音让我很烦恼。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The question that bothered me most before the departure was: Am I really going to be alone?

vocab_pack.definition_en: the act of leaving a place
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 the departure 特指那次出发，作介词 before 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Please arrive at the airport two hours before departure.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 请在出发前两小时到达机场。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The question that bothered me most before the departure was: Am I really going to be alone?

vocab_pack.definition_en: a trip taken alone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，在原文中作主语，this first solo trip。
vocab_pack.example_en: A solo trip can be a great way to discover yourself.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 独自旅行是发现自我的好方法。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Strangely, this first solo trip also was the first trip during which I encountered many people.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to meet or experience something unexpectedly
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 encountered 为一般过去时，主语 I，后接宾语 many people。
vocab_pack.example_en: I encountered an old friend on the street yesterday.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 昨天我在街上偶遇了一位老朋友。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Strangely, this first solo trip also was the first trip during which I encountered many people.

vocab_pack.term: of all ages, styles, and origins
vocab_pack.form_in_passage: of all ages, all styles and all origins
vocab_pack.definition_en: from various age groups, types, and backgrounds
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 各种年龄、风格和背景的
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语作定语，修饰 travelers。原文中重复了 all 以加强语气。
vocab_pack.example_en: The festival attracts people of all ages, styles, and origins.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个节日吸引了各种年龄、风格和背景的人。
vocab_pack.from_passage: travelers of all ages, all styles and all origins.

vocab_pack.definition_en: not often; seldom
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 rarely 位于 have 与 been 之间，表示频率。
vocab_pack.example_en: She rarely eats meat.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她很少吃肉。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I have rarely been alone, even when I was desperate to sit quietly and read a book.

vocab_pack.definition_en: feeling a strong need or desire to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 desperate 用在 was desperate to sit quietly 结构中，形容词 + 不定式表示“极度渴望做某事”。
vocab_pack.example_en: He was desperate to find a job.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他迫切地想找到一份工作。
vocab_pack.from_passage: even when I was desperate to sit quietly and read a book.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to read a book
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为不定式短语，与 to sit quietly 并列，都作 desperate 的补足语。
vocab_pack.example_en: I like to read a book before going to bed.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我喜欢睡前看书。
vocab_pack.from_passage: even when I was desperate to sit quietly and read a book.

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to emphasize that something happens despite a particular circumstance
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 连词，引导让步状语从句。原文中 even when I was desperate... 表示“即使在我极度渴望……的时候”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Even when tired, she keeps working.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 即使累了，她也继续工作。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I have rarely been alone, even when I was desperate to sit quietly and read a book.

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to indicate that something happens on some occasions
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 there were 为一般过去时，when 引导定语从句修饰 times。
vocab_pack.example_en: There are times when you need to be alone.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 有时候你需要独自一人。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Surely, there were times when I imagined how different it would have been with my family.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to become lost; to lose one's way
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 got lost 为一般过去时，表示“迷路了”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Don't get lost in the forest.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 别在森林里迷路了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: especially when I got lost while trying to find my hotel.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to locate one's hotel
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 find my hotel 为不定式短语，与 trying to 连用。
vocab_pack.example_en: She had trouble finding her hotel in the dark.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她在黑暗中找不到她住的酒店。
vocab_pack.from_passage: especially when I got lost while trying to find my hotel.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to travel by bus that operates at night
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 traveled 为一般过去时，on a night bus 为介词短语作方式状语。
vocab_pack.example_en: It's safer to travel on a night bus with a friend.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 和朋友一起坐夜班公交车更安全。
vocab_pack.from_passage: when I traveled on a night bus next to a man who kept talking to me.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to continue doing something without stopping
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 kept 为 keep 的过去式，后接动名词 talking，表示“一直说话”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The baby kept crying all night.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 婴儿哭了一整夜。
vocab_pack.from_passage: next to a man who kept talking to me.

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: so annoying that I could hardly sleep
vocab_pack.definition_en: used to show cause and result; to such a degree that
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 so + 形容词 (annoying) + that 引导结果状语从句。
vocab_pack.example_en: The movie was so boring that I fell asleep.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 电影太无聊了，我睡着了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: which was so annoying that I could hardly sleep.

vocab_pack.definition_en: very great energy
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，在原文中作 gave 的直接宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The hike gave us enormous energy.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 徒步旅行给了我们巨大的能量。
vocab_pack.from_passage: This trip gave me enormous energy and all the doubts and fears before the departure had disappeared.

vocab_pack.definition_en: uncertainties and anxieties
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，在原文中作主语（与 energy 并列），谓语 had disappeared。
vocab_pack.example_en: She overcame her doubts and fears and finally succeeded.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她克服了疑虑和恐惧，最终成功了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: This trip gave me enormous energy and all the doubts and fears before the departure had disappeared.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to vanish; to cease to be visible
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 had disappeared 为过去完成时，表示在某个过去时间之前已经消失（即出发前的疑虑在旅行结束前就消失了）。
vocab_pack.example_en: The sun had disappeared behind the clouds before we arrived.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们到达之前太阳已经躲到云层后面去了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: all the doubts and fears before the departure had disappeared.

vocab_pack.definition_en: optimistic and uplifting energy
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，在原文中作 felt 的宾语，前面有 huge 修饰。
vocab_pack.example_en: She always radiates positive energy.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她总是散发着正能量。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I only felt huge positive energy!

vocab_pack.definition_en: carefully arranged in advance
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复合形容词，在原文中修饰 trip，前面有 very 修饰。
vocab_pack.example_en: A well-planned vacation can relieve stress.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 精心计划的假期可以缓解压力。
vocab_pack.from_passage: It was a very well-planned trip but it was still the most unexpected journey I ever had!

vocab_pack.definition_en: not expected; surprising
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 unexpected 为形容词最高级 the most unexpected，修饰 journey。
vocab_pack.example_en: The sudden rain was unexpected.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这场突如其来的雨出乎意料。
vocab_pack.from_passage: it was still the most unexpected journey I ever had!

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: However hard we try to plan
vocab_pack.definition_en: no matter how (used to introduce a concession)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 让步状语从句的句式，however 后接形容词 (hard)，然后正常语序的主谓结构。
vocab_pack.example_en: However difficult the problem is, we must solve it.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 无论问题多难，我们都必须解决。
vocab_pack.from_passage: However hard we try to plan the trip, there will always be surprises and accidents.

vocab_pack.definition_en: valuable and memorable
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词短语，在原文中修饰 experience。
vocab_pack.example_en: Studying abroad gave me a rich and unforgettable experience.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 出国留学给了我一丰富而难忘的经历。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Now I do understand what a "rich and unforgettable experience" is.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be by oneself; to have no company
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 be alone 为不定式短语，与 going to 连用构成将来时，表“将会独自一人”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Sometimes it's good to be alone and think.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 有时候独自一人思考一下挺好的。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Am I really going to be alone?

section_2_word_form.passage:
Few animals can survive in the Gobi Desert like wild camels, where temperatures range from over 40℃ in summer to -40℃ in winter. However, experts believe that there are now only about 1,000 wild camels [56]. Luckily, rescue may be at hand from an unlikely source: space technology.
The wild camels are distributed across the vast land, [57] it impossible to track or monitor them accurately. Liu Shaochuang, [58] remote sensing specialist, realised that he was in a unique position to help with remote sensing — the use of satellites.
The first step is [59] camels with tracking collars that link to satellites, [60] can be used to determine their positions daily. Once the camels' key habitats [61], Liu's team study the environment with the remote sensing technology. They can study extensive data regarding the camels' movements, the ecological impact of climate change, [62] other potential threats, all from his desk in Beijing. It is this [63] approach to conservation that earned Liu his Rolex Award for Enterprise. Nevertheless, he [64] returns to the Gobi Desert to continue his work.
Liu's work with the wild camel is just the start, and he hopes that the series of [65] his team have developed can help protect other endangered animals.

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词作后置定语。leave与前面的名词wild camels之间是动宾关系（被剩下），所以用过去分词left表示“剩下的野骆驼”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(left): 语境句: I only have ten dollars left in my wallet. 固定搭配: be left behind, nothing left。原词leave其它变形: leaving (现在分词/动名词).

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词作状语。逗号前是一个完整的句子，此处用现在分词making作结果状语，表示“野骆驼分布在广阔的土地上，这使得(making)准确追踪它们变得不可能”。make与主句描述的现象是主动关系。
questions.supplement: 正确形(making): 语境句: The heavy rain continued for days, making the road impassable. 固定搭配: making it possible/impossible to do, decision-making。原词make其它常见用法: make up, make sense.

questions.explanation: 考查冠词。remote sensing specialist(遥感专家)是可数名词单数，且此处泛指“一位”遥感专家，作Liu Shaochuang的同位语。remote发音以辅音音素开头，故填a。
questions.supplement: 正确形(a): 语境句: My brother is working as a computer programmer in that company. 固定搭配: a variety of, a great deal of.

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词作表语。The first step is... (第一步是……)，主语是step, plan, purpose等词时，表语通常用动词不定式表示将来的具体动作。故填to fit。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to fit): 语境句: The next step is to fit the pieces together. 固定搭配: fit sth with sth (给某物安装某物), fit in with。原词fit其它变形: fitness (n.), fitted (过去式/过去分词).

questions.explanation: 考查非限制性定语从句。逗号后是定语从句，先行词是tracking collars (或satellites，均指物)，在从句中作主语，故使用关系代词which。
questions.supplement: 正确形(which): 语境句: He failed the exam again, which disappointed his parents greatly. 固定搭配: in which, of which.

questions.explanation: 考查时态、语态和主谓一致。Once引导条件/时间状语从句，主语habitats与identify之间是被动关系。结合主句“Liu's team study...”为一般现在时，从句也应用一般现在时的被动语态(或者现在完成时的被动语态have been identified)。主语为复数，故填are identified (或have been identified)。
questions.supplement: 正确形(are identified): 语境句: Problems are identified and solved quickly by the team. 固定搭配: identify with, be successfully identified。原词identify其它变形: identity (n. 身份), identification (n. 鉴定，证明).

questions.explanation: 考查连词。分析句子结构，the camels' movements, the ecological impact... 和 other potential threats 是并列关系，列举了团队可以研究的三个数据方面，故填并列连词and。
questions.supplement: 正确形(and): 语境句: She enjoys reading, painting, and playing the piano. 固定搭配: both... and..., and so on.

questions.explanation: 考查词性转换。空格修饰名词approach (方法)，需要用形容词形式。innovate的形容词形式为innovative (创新的，革新的)。
questions.supplement: 正确形(innovative): 语境句: The company is known for its innovative approach to product design. 固定搭配: innovative ideas, innovative solutions。原词innovate其它变形: innovation (n. 创新), innovator (n. 创新者).

questions.explanation: 考查词性转换。空格修饰动词returns，需要用副词形式。regular的副词为regularly (定期地，经常地)。
questions.supplement: 正确形(regularly): 语境句: To keep healthy, you should exercise regularly. 固定搭配: regularly update, meet regularly。原词regular其它变形: regularity (n. 规律性), irregular (adj. 不规则的).

questions.explanation: 考查名词单复数。a series of (一系列的) 后接可数名词时需用复数形式。strategy是可数名词，变复数需把y变i加es，故填strategies。
questions.supplement: 正确形(strategies): 语境句: The government has proposed several new strategies to reduce pollution. 固定搭配: a series of strategies, marketing strategies。原词strategy其它变形: strategic (adj. 战略的), strategically (adv. 战略上地).

vocab_pack.definition_en: to continue to live or exist in spite of danger or difficulty
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中用在情态动词can之后，使用动词原形，表示有能力在戈壁沙漠中生存。
vocab_pack.example_en: Only a few species can survive in extreme conditions.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 只有少数物种能在极端条件下生存。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Few animals can survive in the Gobi Desert like wild camels

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: range from over 40℃ in summer to -40℃ in winter
vocab_pack.definition_en: to vary within specified limits from one extreme to another
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作谓语，一般现在时，主语temperatures为复数，动词range用原形。表示温度在40℃以上到零下40℃之间变化。
vocab_pack.example_en: The ages of the students range from 18 to 25.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 学生们的年龄从18岁到25岁不等。
vocab_pack.from_passage: where temperatures range from over 40℃ in summer to -40℃ in winter

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be close in time or likely to happen soon
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中用在情态动词may之后，be动词用原形，表示救援可能即将来临。
vocab_pack.example_en: With final exams around the corner, help is at hand from the tutoring center.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 随着期末考试临近，辅导中心的帮助近在咫尺。
vocab_pack.from_passage: rescue may be at hand from an unlikely source

vocab_pack.definition_en: to spread something over an area
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为被动语态（are distributed），过去分词distributed与be动词构成被动，表示被分布在广阔的土地上。
vocab_pack.example_en: The population is distributed across the country unevenly.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 人口在全国分布不均。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The wild camels are distributed across the vast land

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: making it impossible to track or monitor them accurately
vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause a situation where something cannot be done
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中现在分词短语making作结果状语，it为形式宾语，真正宾语为to track or monitor them accurately。
vocab_pack.example_en: The heavy rain made it impossible to go outside.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 大雨使得出门成为不可能。
vocab_pack.from_passage: making it impossible to track or monitor them accurately

vocab_pack.definition_en: to follow the movements of someone or something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中跟在不定式to之后，用动词原形，与monitor并列，表示难以跟踪或监测它们。
vocab_pack.example_en: Scientists use GPS to track animal migration patterns.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 科学家使用全球定位系统追踪动物迁徙模式。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to track or monitor them accurately

vocab_pack.definition_en: to watch and check something over a period of time
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中与track并列，跟在不定式to之后，用动词原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: Doctors monitor patients' vital signs regularly.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 医生定期监测患者的生命体征。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to track or monitor them accurately

vocab_pack.definition_en: in a way that is correct and exact
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中副词修饰动词track和monitor，表示无法准确地追踪或监测。
vocab_pack.example_en: The GPS can locate your position accurately.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 全球定位系统能准确定位你的位置。
vocab_pack.from_passage: track or monitor them accurately

vocab_pack.term: be in a unique position to do
vocab_pack.form_in_passage: was in a unique position to help
vocab_pack.definition_en: to have a special opportunity or ability to do something
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 处于一个独特的位置（因而有可能做某事）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中was为过去式，表示过去处于独特位置，后接不定式to help。
vocab_pack.example_en: Having studied abroad, she is in a unique position to understand cultural differences.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 由于曾在国外学习，她处于一个独特的位置去理解文化差异。
vocab_pack.from_passage: he was in a unique position to help with remote sensing

vocab_pack.definition_en: to assist in doing something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中help with后接名词短语remote sensing，表示在遥感领域提供帮助。
vocab_pack.example_en: He often helps with the housework on weekends.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他周末经常帮忙做家务。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to help with remote sensing

vocab_pack.definition_en: the science of obtaining information about the Earth's surface using satellites or aircraft
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作名词短语，是介词with的宾语，表示利用卫星的技术。
vocab_pack.example_en: Remote sensing plays a key role in climate monitoring.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 遥感在气候监测中起着关键作用。
vocab_pack.from_passage: help with remote sensing — the use of satellites

vocab_pack.definition_en: to provide something (with a necessary part or device)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中不定式短语to fit camels with tracking collars，fit为动词原形，camels是宾语，with后接装备。
vocab_pack.example_en: The factory fits all new cars with airbags.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这家工厂为所有新车配备安全气囊。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to fit camels with tracking collars

vocab_pack.definition_en: to connect or join something to something else
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中that引导定语从句修饰collars，link to为动词短语，主语collars为复数，因此用原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: The device links to the internet via Wi-Fi.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该设备通过Wi-Fi连接到互联网。
vocab_pack.from_passage: tracking collars that link to satellites

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be employed for a particular purpose
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中can be used为情态动词的被动语态，be used to determine表示可以被用来确定位置。
vocab_pack.example_en: The data can be used to predict weather patterns.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这些数据可以用来预测天气模式。
vocab_pack.from_passage: which can be used to determine their positions daily

vocab_pack.definition_en: to discover the facts about something; to calculate something exactly
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中在不定式to之后，用动词原形，表示被用来确定它们的位置。
vocab_pack.example_en: We need to determine the cause of the accident.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们需要确定事故的原因。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to determine their positions daily

vocab_pack.definition_en: to recognize or name someone or something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中are identified为一般现在时被动语态，表示骆驼的关键栖息地被识别出来。
vocab_pack.example_en: The police identified the suspect from the video footage.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 警方从视频片段中识别出嫌疑人。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Once the camels' key habitats are identified

vocab_pack.definition_en: covering a large area; large in amount
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中修饰名词data，表示广泛的数据。
vocab_pack.example_en: The research involved extensive data collection.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这项研究涉及广泛的数据收集。
vocab_pack.from_passage: study extensive data regarding the camels' movements

vocab_pack.definition_en: about; concerning
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作介词，后接名词短语the camels' movements等，表示关于骆驼活动的数据。
vocab_pack.example_en: Please provide information regarding your work experience.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 请提供关于您工作经验的信息。
vocab_pack.from_passage: extensive data regarding the camels' movements

vocab_pack.definition_en: the effect that human activities or natural events have on the environment
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作名词短语，与climate change并列，是研究的内容之一。
vocab_pack.example_en: Deforestation has a severe ecological impact on biodiversity.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 森林砍伐对生物多样性有严重的生态影响。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the ecological impact of climate change

vocab_pack.definition_en: long-term changes in temperature and weather patterns
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作名词短语，是ecological impact的修饰对象。
vocab_pack.example_en: Climate change is one of the greatest challenges facing humanity.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 气候变化是人类面临的最大挑战之一。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the ecological impact of climate change

vocab_pack.definition_en: a possible danger or harm
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中与movements, ecological impact并列，为复数形式threats，表示其他潜在威胁。
vocab_pack.example_en: Pollution is a potential threat to marine life.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 污染是对海洋生命的潜在威胁。
vocab_pack.from_passage: other potential threats

vocab_pack.definition_en: introducing new ideas or methods
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中修饰名词approach，表示创新的方法。
vocab_pack.example_en: The company is known for its innovative products.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这家公司以其创新产品而闻名。
vocab_pack.from_passage: It is this innovative approach to conservation

vocab_pack.definition_en: a way of dealing with a problem or situation
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中approach后跟介词to，表示对待保护的方法。注意approach to后接名词或动名词。
vocab_pack.example_en: We need a new approach to solving the traffic problem.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们需要一种新的方法来解决交通问题。
vocab_pack.from_passage: this innovative approach to conservation

vocab_pack.definition_en: the protection of the natural environment
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作名词，是approach to的宾语，表示环境保护。
vocab_pack.example_en: Wildlife conservation is essential for maintaining biodiversity.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 野生动物保护对于维持生物多样性至关重要。
vocab_pack.from_passage: approach to conservation

vocab_pack.definition_en: to receive money or an award for work done
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中earned为过去式，表示创新方法为他赢得了劳力士企业奖。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her hard work earned her a promotion.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她的努力工作为她赢得了晋升。
vocab_pack.from_passage: that earned Liu his Rolex Award for Enterprise

vocab_pack.definition_en: despite what has just been said
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中句首，表示转折，连接前后两个句子。注意首字母大写。
vocab_pack.example_en: The project faced many difficulties; nevertheless, they completed it on time.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 项目遇到了许多困难，尽管如此，他们还是按时完成了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Nevertheless, he regularly returns to the Gobi Desert

vocab_pack.definition_en: every day
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中副词修饰动词determine，表示每天确定它们的位置。
vocab_pack.example_en: The magazine is published daily.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这本杂志每天出版。
vocab_pack.from_passage: determine their positions daily

vocab_pack.definition_en: to create or produce something new over a period of time
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中have developed为现在完成时，表示团队已经开发了一系列策略。
vocab_pack.example_en: The team has developed a new software system.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该团队开发了一套新的软件系统。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the series of strategies his team have developed

vocab_pack.definition_en: to assist in protecting something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中help后直接跟动词原形protect（不带to），表示帮助保护其他濒危动物。这是help的常见用法。
vocab_pack.example_en: Planting trees can help protect the environment.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 植树可以帮助保护环境。
vocab_pack.from_passage: can help protect other endangered animals

vocab_pack.definition_en: at risk of extinction
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中形容词修饰名词animals，表示其他濒危动物。
vocab_pack.example_en: The giant panda is an endangered species.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 大熊猫是一种濒危物种。
vocab_pack.from_passage: other endangered animals
